I am an undergraduate at Boston University studying mathematics, physics, and computer science.

I am currently a research intern at the Max Planck Institute for the Physics of Complex Systems in Dresden, working on many-body quantum systems.

Outside of research, I enjoy tennis, poker, and cooking.

Research interests

My interests lie at the intersection of probability, statistical mechanics, and the mathematical foundations of machine learning.

  • Probability & high-dimensional statistics
  • Random matrix theory
  • Statistical mechanics & quantum many-body systems
  • Mathematical foundations of learning & optimization
